cleanser

Source: CLAUDE.md

R package of utility functions to check, clean and prepare a dataset. Not yet on CRAN (version 0.0.0.9000).

Language

  • Write all documentation, code comments, messages, errors and commit messages in English.
  • Talk to the maintainer in French in the conversation.
  • Some existing code comments are still in French and are being translated.

Design

  • Follow the tidyverse style guide (https://style.tidyverse.org) and the tidy design principles (https://design.tidyverse.org).
  • Functions that work on a data frame take it as their first argument and return a data frame, so they work in a pipe.
  • Column-selection arguments accept tidyselect syntax ({{ }}, tidyselect::eval_select()), not only character vectors.
  • Use snake_case, no abbreviations in exported names (with, not w).
  • Call functions from imported packages as pkg::fun().
  • Write error messages as the tidyverse style guide describes (say what went wrong and where).

Naming

  • Every exported function uses the cln_ prefix and the order cln_verb_target_criterion(), e.g. cln_keep_col_numeric(), cln_discard_row_empty(), cln_keep_col_with_levels().
  • clr_ is the old prefix: do not use it (it clashes with the prismatic package and with “centered log-ratio”).
  • The re-exported pipe %>% keeps its name.
  • Verb families: keep_ / discard_ (return the data with the columns or rows that match / do not match a criterion), detect_, is_, has_ (return logicals), extract_ (return the rows that do not match expectations), fix_ (correct values), recode_, classify_, split_, compute_, compose_, convert_, create_, translate_, round_.
  • The package is not released yet: renames need no deprecated aliases.

Tooling

  • Document with roxygen2 in markdown; every exported function has @examples.
  • Test with testthat (3rd edition); add or update tests with every change.
  • NAMESPACE and man/ are generated by devtools::document(). R is not available in cloud sessions: when a rename forces edits there, keep them strictly mechanical and ask the maintainer to run devtools::document() locally.
  • Before saying a change is done: devtools::document(), devtools::test(), devtools::check().
  • Keep CLAUDE.md listed in .Rbuildignore.

Vignettes

  • Structure: introduction (the problem solved, 2–3 sentences); a small example dataset covering every case; the functions grouped by task (check → extract → recode), each shown with one example and one sentence; optional “How it works” section for internals.
  • Name the arguments in examples (id_cols = "id", not "id").
  • Example data in English. No commented-out code or development notes.
  • vignettes/factor.Rmd is the reference model once it has been rewritten.

Working rules

  • Do not change a function’s behaviour unless the maintainer asks; propose the change first.
  • One kind of change per commit (rename, translation, behaviour fix).
  • For wide changes (renames, refactors), show the plan first, e.g. an “old name → new name” table, and wait for approval.

Known issues and pending decisions (do not act unless asked)

  • The cln_extract_mismatch_* functions do not accept tidyselect id_cols, unlike keep_ / discard_.
  • The code uses \(x): DESCRIPTION needs Depends: R (>= 4.1.0).
  • Commented-out code in R/join.R and R/mutate.R.
  • Tests exist only for dummy and factor.
  • cln_is_shared_values_across_rows() is defined twice, identically, in R/join.R and R/unite.R: keep one.
  • cln_split_median() duplicates cln_classify_median() (only the na.rm default differs): decide which one to keep.
  • cln_recode_col_non_oui() is French-specific: planned to become a documentation example of cln_recode_col_with_levels() + purrr::partial() instead of an export.
  • Doc titles to fix: cln_map_mismatch_cols_with_suffix reuses the title of cln_extract_mismatch_2cols; cln_create_lut_from_dictionary title does not describe it; typo “jon” in cln_left_join_fuzzy_date.

Commands

  • devtools::document(), devtools::test(), devtools::check(), pkgdown::build_site().
